modules.name: catalog/sessions
modules.src:
# Sessions: gap-based sessionization per user.
#
# Input: one row per event, sorted by (user, ts); ts in int64 nanoseconds.
# A session is a run of a user's events in which no two consecutive events
# are more than `gap` apart. A gap of exactly `gap` keeps the session going;
# a longer one starts a new session. Rows at the same instant share a session.
#
#   session_start      ts of the session's first event (with user, the session's id)
#   session_index      how many sessions of the user started before this one
#   secs_since_start   (ts - session_start) in seconds
#   n_prev_in_session  events of the session with an earlier ts (same instant excluded)
#
# Every output at a row reads only rows of the same user with ts <= the row's ts.

from rows import group_end, instant_end

NS_PER_S: Int = 1000000000

record Sessions {
    session_start: [Int]
    session_index: [Int]
    secs_since_start: Arr
    n_prev_in_session: [Int]
}

#| Gap-based sessions for events sorted by (user, ts): each row's session start,
#| the session's index within the user, the seconds since the session started and
#| the number of earlier events in the session.
#|| One pass per user, one instant at a time: a gap longer than `gap` before an
#|| instant closes the session.
#||| A session id built from a global running counter would change when an
#||| earlier user gains sessions in the future; the start time does not.
#: user  the entity key, sorted ascending
#: ts  event time, int64 nanoseconds, ascending within a user
#: gap  the longest gap, in nanoseconds, that keeps a session open
#@ 27f60b7d
def sessions(user: [Int], ts: [Int], gap: Int) -> Sessions {
    n = len(ts)
    start = int_zeros(n)
    index = int_zeros(n)
    secs = zeros(n)
    nprev = int_zeros(n)
    g: Int = 0
    while g < n {
        stop_at = group_end(user, ts, g, "sessions")
        s_start: Int = ts[g]
        s_index: Int = 0
        s_count: Int = 0
        i: Int = g
        while i < stop_at {
            same = instant_end(ts, i, stop_at)
            step split "a gap longer than the limit opens a new session" {
                if i > g and ts[i] - ts[i - 1] > gap {
                    s_start = ts[i]
                    s_index += 1
                    s_count = 0
                }
            }
            step fill "the rows of the instant share the session and its past" {
                for k from i to same {
                    start[k] = s_start
                    index[k] = s_index
                    nprev[k] = s_count
                    secs[k] = float(ts[k] - s_start) / float(NS_PER_S)
                }
                s_count += same - i
            }
            i = same
        }
        g = stop_at
    }
    return Sessions { session_start: start, session_index: index, secs_since_start: secs, n_prev_in_session: nprev }
}

test "a gap of exactly the limit keeps the session; a longer one splits it" {
    user: [Int] = [1, 1, 1, 1, 2]
    ts: [Int] = [0, 10, 10, 30, 0]
    s = sessions(user, ts, 20)
    assert_true(s.session_index[3] == 0 and s.session_start[3] == 0)
    t = sessions(user, ts, 19)
    assert_true(t.session_index[3] == 1 and t.session_start[3] == 30)
    assert_true(s.n_prev_in_session[1] == 1 and s.n_prev_in_session[2] == 1 and s.n_prev_in_session[3] == 3)
    assert_true(s.session_index[4] == 0 and s.n_prev_in_session[4] == 0)
}
